content_sections.heading: SKAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SKAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SKAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SKAU Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Technical Advisor and 1 for Junior Consultant (Matron).

content_sections.heading: SKAU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technical Advisor: B.E./B. Tech. or equivalent in the relevant field from a recognized Institute/University. Minimum 10 years of total experience in an Engineering capacity out of which 05 years as S.E. and/or C.E. (after obtaining the requisite degree) in PWD (B&R), Haryana or equivalent in Central Govt. Desirable: Post-Graduate Diploma in Management/MBA/M.E./M.Tech. Junior Consultant (Matron): Person from the post of Nursing Sister & above of any State Govt./ Centre Govt. and having 3-5 years' experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: SKAU Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Technical Advisor: Rs. 4000/- per visit (Max. upto 50,000/- per month) Junior Consultant (Matron): Rs. 35,000/- per month OR Rs. 3000/- per visit (Max. upto 35,000/-)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SKAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SKAU Consultant/Technical Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 24-09-2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Advisor post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Advisor post, candidates need to have a B.E./B. Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant field. A Post-Graduate Diploma in Management/MBA/M.E./M.Tech. is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the experience required for the Junior Consultant (Matron) post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Consultant (Matron) post, candidates should be from the post of Nursing Sister & above of any State Govt./ Centre Govt. and possess 3-5 years of experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Technical Advisor position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Technical Advisor is Rs. 4000/- per visit, with a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Junior Consultant (Matron) post?
faq.answer: The Junior Consultant (Matron) will receive Rs. 35,000/- per month or Rs. 3000/- per visit, with a maximum limit of Rs. 35,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no maximum age limit mentioned for any of the posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Consultant/Technical Advisor posts at SKAU?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for SKAU Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Shri Krishna AYUSH University Kurukshetra, Haryana, Pin code: 136118.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original certificates/testimonials, a self-attested copy of educational documents, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or temporary job?
faq.answer: The job type for these Consultant/Technical Advisor posts is temporary.
